wholeGoal.title: Biologische und kulturelle Evolution des Menschen rekonstruieren
wholeGoal.titleEn: Reconstruct Biological and Cultural Human Evolution
wholeGoal.description: Die lernende Person kann aus Merkmalen fossiler Funde Hypothesen zur biologischen Evolution des modernen Menschen ableiten, eine zeitliche Reihenfolge rekonstruieren und die Bedeutung kultureller Evolution für den heutigen Menschen analysieren.
wholeGoal.descriptionEn: The learner can derive hypotheses about biological human evolution from fossil traits, reconstruct a chronological sequence, and analyze the importance of cultural evolution for humans today.

knownCounterfindingBeforeThisFollowup: EVO12-V-A-PIXEL-001: actor-facing perspective of previous open tool book
independence: Other reviewer counterfinding was communicated after my sealed twelve-image FIRST. My earlier KEEP and its exact judgments remain unchanged historical evidence. I did not read the other reviewer folder. New pixels are assessed before their own metadata, prompts or author QC.
priorJudgmentLimitation: My prior observation that neither person was writing in or looking at the book did not adequately protect the intended acting-person orientation of its displayed learning sequence. The counterfinding identifies a relevant perspective ambiguity that the new asset removes.
scientificObservation: Fossil skull/pelvis fragments, relative older-to-younger direction, question-marked alternative relationships and separate human cultural explanation remain correctly schematic. Both people communicate about the held stone. The tabletop book is now closed: no pages, instructions, directional entry or symbols are presented to an external observer while the actors sit opposite. No mirror/letter reversal or new biological claim appears.
phoneObservation: At actual 360 the three panel headings, fossils, uncertain branch topology, held tool, speech bubble and closed book remain identifiable. The small explanatory paragraphs are supplementary; the principal scientific distinctions are carried by the large objects and question marks.
desktopObservation: At actual 680 labels and cultural action are clear. The closed blank book remains a simple supporting knowledge icon, not a readable record.
scope: KEEP as overview for current combined fossil/culture goal only. The change does not resolve atomarity, source duties, chronology, native page/P bindings or any proposed child image.
